visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar, which may cause confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Consider using more distinct colors for water and roads.

visualRisks.description: The lighthouse is not easily distinguishable against the ground color.
visualRisks.suggestion: Increase contrast between the lighthouse and the surrounding ground.

navigationRisks.description: There are multiple consecutive right turns (rr) which could be confusing for players.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Diversify the path to include more left or straight movements.

navigationRisks.description: The route includes a long stretch of water without any landmarks, which might disorient players.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add some visual cues like houses or docks along the water path.
